title: Cavern Gale Bass
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A roaring mid-register sawtooth bass blended with sculpted pink/brown noise, rhythmically gated by a stepping tremolo and swept by a cavernous band-pass. Over 32 cycles the noise blend, fm growl and filter sweep travel on prime clocks, so the wind-tunnel howl slowly opens and closes without ever quite repeating.
code:
setcpm(132/4)
stack(
  note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1 c2 [bb1 g1] eb2 f2>*2").s("sawtooth")
    .fm(sine.slow(19).range(1.5, 7)).fmh("<1 2 1.5 0.5>/4")
    .noise(sine.slow(23).range(0.05, 0.45))
    .penv("<0 0 7 -4>/8").pattack(0.002).pdecay(0.09)
    .bpf(sine.slow(32).range(220, 2600)).resonance(16).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2.5).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.18)
    .tremolosync("<4 8 4 16>/8").tremolodepth(sine.slow(11).range(0.3, 0.85))
    .shape(sine.slow(13).range(0.2, 0.5)).coarse("<1 1 2 1>/4")
    .attack(0.004).decay(0.22).sustain(0.55).release(0.07)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).vowel("<o u a>/3"))
    .room(sine.slow(29).range(0.25, 0.7)).delay("0.35:0.5:0.6")
    .gain(0.9)
)
